integrity: The universal classification is symbolic: equality forces one of three divisor-count pairs \((3,2),(4,2),(4,3)\), which are completely resolved. The finite checker through \(10^6\) is regression evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only inputs \(n\ge2\) with \(\Omega(n)\le2\); it does not classify higher-almost-prime collisions or prove infinitude of prime pairs with \(qr+2\) prime.
title: Exact collision fibers of \(n+\tau(n)\) on \(2\)-almost-primes
